"""
LRU Cache with TTL Expiry and Thread-Safety Module.

This module implements a high-performance, thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU)
cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration support. It is designed for scenarios
where cached data has a limited lifespan and needs to be evicted based on both
access frequency (LRU policy) and age (TTL policy).

Features:
- LRU eviction policy: When the cache reaches its maximum capacity, the least
  recently used item is evicted to make room for new items.
- TTL Expiry: Each cached item has an associated time-to-live. If an item is
  accessed after its TTL has expired, it is treated as non-existent and can be
  evicted.
- Thread-Safety: The cache is fully thread-safe, allowing concurrent reads and
  writes from multiple threads without data corruption or race conditions.
- Configurable Parameters: Users can specify the maximum cache size, default TTL,
  and custom TTL per item (if supported by the implementation).
- Comprehensive Documentation: Extensive inline comments and docstrings for
  maintainability and ease of use.

Dependencies:
- Python 3.7+ (for ordered dictionaries and type hinting improvements).
- threading (for mutex locks).
- time (for timestamp management).
- pytest (for testing, required for the test suite).

    >>> cache.set("key1", "value1")
    >>> value = cache.get("key1")
